rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when something is achieved or perceived only with difficulty or by a narrow margin.

example.english: I barely managed to catch the train.
example.traditional: 我勉強先至趕得切班車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 min5 koeng5 sin1 zi3 gon2 dak1 cit3 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this before a negative expression when something is almost not happening at all, as in barely seeing something.

example.english: I could barely see the word.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei1 fu4 tai2 m4 dou2 go3 zi6

rows.note: Use this written-form choice when emphasizing that the result was only just enough or by a small margin.

example.english: We barely lost, by just one point.
example.traditional: 我哋僅僅以一分之差輸咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gan2 gan2 ji5 jat1 fan1 zi1 caa1 syu1 zo2
